name: phd-qualifier-extension-runs-out
description: DGS 2026-09-13: a §4.4 qualifier extension is granted ONE additional semester at a time. The old boolean forgave lateness with no time bound at all, so a research qualifier years past its deadline still read "due soon" against the original date, forever. Entry Fall 2026 puts the 18-month mark at mid-Spring 2028; the extension runs to the end of Fall 2028; by mid-2029 the row is overdue again.
